title: Added AI opponents to my browser RTS game TinyRTS using Codex in a few hours. Has the same information as players and is actually quite efficient at getting resources and building its base. Very easy now for newcomers to practice the game!
author: zebleck

comments.author: zebleck
comments.body:
Check it out at [tiny-rts.com](http://tiny-rts.com) 

Would've taken me weeks to get to a comparable level in the past. Codex just pretty much one-shots a basic AI, then tunes it with a few prompts. Absolutely amazing!

replies.author: fastpicker89
replies.body: Def will try out later. What engine?

replies.author: zebleck
replies.body: No game engine, pure HTML 5 Canvas/Webgl and node javascript.

replies.author: fastpicker89
replies.body: Dude hell yeah I’m on the same path rn

replies.author: pxng0lin
replies.body:
How are you creating the sprites, map, etc, are you ai generating them or getting them from somewhere?

I'm trying to understand this part, I began making a game, created ai generated sprites bit it's not going well, and yes I'm completely new to ai game dev lol

replies.author: zebleck
replies.body: I gave up on trying to generate art assets with AI. Breakthrough was using human made asset packs. Using the beautiful Tiny Swords pack by PixelFrog: [https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords](https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords)

replies.author: CurtChan
replies.body: neat, i was thinking of doing something similar with ai myself. will give it more try later

comments.author: kraboo_team
comments.body: Whats the difference between the AI enemies and the classic enemies ? What they have prompted ?

replies.author: zebleck
replies.body: There were no classic enemies. Before, you could either play against other humans or against noone. Now you can actually play against something that reacts to you.

replies.author: kraboo_team
replies.body: Ok sounds good, great job. So now the each game is different. How do you handle the level of difficulty?

comments.author: Revolutionary_Heart6
comments.body: You need to make map with expansions for player to contest them

replies.author: zebleck
replies.body: Great idea. To be honest, we're still lacking in a big number of great maps, although we have some. But the map editor is live for anyone to build and publish maps. If you want, publish your vision and I will get some players to play it with you!

comments.body: Very nice! I like the time lapse
